content.short: Oriole Insights is a one-of-a-kind price prediction platform implemented in a simple gaming format.
content.description: Oriole Insights aims to build a digital community in which reputation stands as the core of a person’s identity. Within this platform, every prediction mirrors the predictor’s experience, track record, and learning from past successes and missteps. By clearly rewarding accuracy and by establishing transparent reputation scores, Oriole Insights creates an ecosystem that recognizes and rewards the most capable forecasters for their insight and judgment.

resources.title: How Prediction Accuracy Builds Reputation on Oriole
resources.tldr: Users forecast price moves, listings and events; accuracy raises reputation and earns ORI. Explains how the scoring and progression actually work.

resources.title: Oriole's ORI Goes Onchain on BNB Testnet
resources.tldr: Moving the platform's currency onto BNB Smart Chain testnet, so ORI can be deposited, withdrawn and sent through MetaMask rather than held off-chain.

resources.title: What Is UMA's Optimistic Oracle?
resources.tldr: Every prediction market rests on who decides what happened. How UMA's dispute-and-bond model settles that for Polymarket, and where it strains.
